name: Haematopoietic stem cell
failures: Inherited haemoglobin and immune defects, clonal expansion to leukaemia, age-related clonal haematopoiesis.

see.note: Marrow aspirate and flow cytometry are standard.

model.note: Lineage output is well defined and measurable.

reach.note: Ex vivo only: harvest, edit outside the body, reinfuse. In vivo HSC targeting is unsolved.

edit.note: Casgevy, ex vivo CRISPR for sickle cell disease, FDA 2023.

verify.note: Chimerism and haemoglobin fractions are directly measurable.
